## STEP 1: Read Webflow source
Read `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/index.html` — find each section by its class name.
Read `/Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq App/Boldteq/boldteq-v1-0.webflow/css/boldteq-v1-0.webflow.css` — grep for EVERY class used in each section.

## STEP 2: Read current files then REWRITE them

### hero.tsx — Section class: `section-high-judge home-ban-judge`
Webflow CSS values to match:
- `.section-high-judge`: padding-top 0, bg white
- `.home-ban-judge`: specific hero layout
- Trustpilot badge image at top
- `.p-base-place`: color #092245, margin-top 1.5rem, font-family Roobert PRO
  - Contains typewriter text: "Ownership Driven" / "Without Hiring" / "On Demand"
  - Font-size 40px, font-weight 700
- `.p-base-place-copy` (h1): color #092245, font-size 40px, font-weight 700, line-height 45px
- `.h1-season-seeing`: font-size 16px, line-height 28px, color #2b2b2b, max-width 52rem
- Trust badges: 3-column grid with icons + text, white cards with shadow 0 0 5px rgba(0,0,0,.1)
- CTA buttons: `.a-gulf-book` (gradient + arrow SVG) and `.a-except-get` (bg #21cfff21 + arrow SVG)
- GuideJar iframe embed: border-radius 10px, padding-bottom calc(56.25% + 32px)

### typewriter.tsx — Client component
- Cycles: "Ownership Driven", "Without Hiring", "On Demand"
- Use framer-motion AnimatePresence for fade transitions
- Color should use gradient text effect (cyan to blue)
- Must match the animated span behavior from Webflow

### featured-logos.tsx — Section class: `section-regular no-padding-mob logo-mob`
- "Featured in:" text label
- Logo images in horizontal ticker/marquee: Forbes, Entrepreneur, Inc., Washington Post, Philadelphia, Technically
- Images from `/images/webflow/` — find exact filenames by reading the HTML
- CSS ticker animation (infinite scroll)
- Grayscale default, color on hover

### portfolio-carousel.tsx — Section class: `section-regular-2 img-slider-sec`
- Webflow slider with 4 visible slides: Shopify, WordPress, Figma UI/UX Design, Banners
- Each slide: aspect-ratio ~1/1.22, border-radius 20px, colored background
  - Shopify: bg #fbf2e4
  - WordPress: bg #e6fccd
  - Figma: bg rgba(77,161,175,0.1)
  - Banners: bg rgba(255,138,138,0.08)
- Category label below each slide with colored text
- Dot indicators: 12px circles, inactive #EDF0F2, active black
- Arrow buttons: circular, outlined, with blue arrow icon
- Use embla-carousel-react + embla-carousel-autoplay
- Section padding: padding-top 20px, padding-left 2%, padding-right 0%, padding-bottom 64px

### pain-points.tsx — Section class: `section-regular-3 slowing-sec`
- Padding: 0 5% 30px, bg transparent
- h2 "What's Slowing Your Agency Down?": 40px/700/45px lh/margin-bottom 24px/center
- Subtitle paragraph: 16px/28px, color #2b2b2b, center
- 3 cards in grid, gap 20px
- Each card: bg #def4ff, border 1px solid #009ce0, border-radius 20px, padding 25px 17px 17px, text-align center
- Card title: 20px, font-weight 700
- Card description: 16px/28px, color #2b2b2b
- Card has illustration image from /images/webflow/
- Cards are clickable (a tags) with hover: bg #c8ecfa, border-color #007db3, transition all .3s

### resolution-banner.tsx — Section class: `blue-card-sec`
- Padding: 0 5%, bg transparent
- Inner card: bg with 3 decorative images (Mask-group-3.png, Mask-group-2.png, Rectangle-254.png), border-radius 20px, padding 20px 40px 40px, gap 30px
- h3: font-size 35px, line-height 45px, max-width 842px, color white, text-align center
- Inline team avatar image in the text
- Schedule Demo button: `.a-gulf-book.dark-bg` variant

### built-for.tsx — Section class: `built-seccc`
- Padding: 60px 5% 0, bg transparent
- h2 "Who Is Boldteq Built For?": 40px/700/45px/mb 24px/center
- Subtitle: 16px/28px/center
- 4-column grid, gap 16px
- Each card: background-image Rectangle-30822.png, border-radius 15px, padding 12px 20px 10px
- Number (#1, #2, etc.): color #05bafe, font-weight bold
- Card title: 18px, font-weight 700
- Card body: 16px, color black

## RULES
- Use inline `style={{}}` for complex CSS (background-images, multi-value backgrounds)
- Use Tailwind for standard values
- `"use client"` only on typewriter.tsx and portfolio-carousel.tsx
- NO `any` types
- Every image: `/images/webflow/FILENAME` — get exact filenames from HTML
- Text WORD FOR WORD from Webflow HTML
- Include ALL responsive breakpoints (991px, 767px, 479px)
- Match EVERY CSS property from Webflow exactly

WRITE ALL FILES NOW.
